summary: Tested TWO new OCR features (CRM business-card OCR panel on /admin/contacts + Import Paste side-by-side layout). Blocked initially by a backend syntax error in /app/server/routers/outreach.ts (orphaned .input(...) block after ocrContactCard mutation — missing procedure name/declaration causing esbuild TransformError at line 588, entire tRPC server crashing, gate-unlock returning 502 'Network error. Try again'). Restored the missing `parseFromUrl: ownerProcedure` declaration (inferred from x-ow-source header 'outreach.parseFromUrl' inside the block). After fix, backend booted cleanly and all feature tests PASSED. FEATURE 1a: card-ocr-panel + card-ocr-upload-label + card-ocr-file-input all present above the Add contact form (panel y=1072 < form-firstName y=1182). FEATURE 1b: Uploaded placehold.co business-card image → card-ocr-running visible during ~40s LLM round-trip → card-ocr-result rendered with score '9 / 9 words recognised', confidence '100%', preview thumbnail, raw OCR text. Auto-fill: form-firstName='Nathan', form-lastName='Bailey', form-mobile='0400 123 456', form-winery='Brokenwood Wines', form-notes contained the OCR blob incl. truncated email. Note: form's mobile testid is `form-mobile` (not `form-mobileAu` as review-request stated); there is NO form-email field in this form (email is intentionally captured in notes). FEATURE 1c: card-ocr-reset click hid card-ocr-result but preserved form fields (form-firstName still 'Nathan') — matches intended behaviour. FEATURE 2: paste-ocr-split rendered as grid with paste-ocr-preview (x=593.6, w=94.5) on LEFT and paste-ocr-text (x=705.1) on RIGHT — side-by-side confirmed via bounding rects; paste-ocr-preview-link count=1 (clickable to enlarge). Preview height 47px because the test image had a small natural size — CSS max-height 340px cap works fine. REGRESSION: text paste ('Tank 7 Shiraz Brix 14.2') into paste-textarea + paste-extract-btn click completed without error toasts.

If main agent replaces the routers with a different structure, ensure that procedure name still exists (frontend likely calls trpc.outreach.parseFromUrl.useMutation). Card OCR + Import Paste both fully working — no need to re-test unless code changes.
rca of the issue: Backend boot crash: An earlier refactor left an orphaned `.input(z.object({ url: ... }))` chain at line 588 of outreach.ts without the preceding `procedureName: ownerProcedure` line, causing esbuild to fail with 'Expected identifier but found .'. This crashed the tRPC HTTP server, so all API mutations including gate-unlock returned 502 → user saw 'Network error. Try again' on the /admin/contacts gate. Fix: added `parseFromUrl: ownerProcedure` on the line before the orphaned .input(...) block. Backend restarted cleanly. Repro: `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` then `tail /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log`.
